body:
Instrumentation semantics correction and progress (not a final conclusion): 3/25 required v2 jobs complete.

Installed Isaac Lab ImplicitActuator documents that its applied_torque is an approximate PD estimate. We therefore preserved all five completed v1 jobs and interrupted sixth separately (completed v1 computation732.075s) and reran the same prescribed conditions with PhysX get_dof_projected_joint_forces (measured active incoming-joint-force component in DOF direction), plus separate approximate PD, explicit actuation input and position targets. This is not a claim that pure implicit motor drive torque is independently exposed. Policies, physical parameters, thresholds, conditions and classification rules SHA remain unchanged.

First v2 seed1/16env: initial observation/action mirror errors about1e-7; exact transformed-input intrinsic policy probe error0. Ground first-step measured joint-force mirror error is about0.012-0.050Nm, while open-loop mirrored position targets match exactly. Air/no-contact, remaining seeds, num_envs1 and perturbation results are still required; no O/N/H conclusion yet. Full component traces and both instrumentation versions are retained remotely. Runtime freeze was separated from independently authored analysis/presentation with a correction ledger; actual simulation runtime hashes and inputs stayed unchanged during queue orchestration repair.

Notion progress is aligned; no Linear synchronization.
